svg.text: Route: /admin/inventory, /admin/barcode (popup) · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin and Staff (admin site, signed in)
• Starts empty: Save adjustment stays disabled until there is an amount that changes the stock and a reason. Reasons: Restock / delivery received, Customer return, Damaged goods, Spoilage,
• Damaged goods and Spoilage can only lower stock (“Damaged goods and spoilage can only lower the stock.”); stock never goes below 0. The preview shows old → new count and the change.
Every save is logged with who made it.

g.text: 3 products at or below minimum stock
